docs.name: DIAGNOSTICS.md
docs.title: Diagnostic codes
docs.description: Every diagnostic a pherolang surface emits carries a stable string code. The codes live in one place — the `phero-diagnostics` crate — and this page is generated from that registry: a new code is a table row in `phero-diagnostics`, never a local constant. Two schemes are registered side by side: the numeric bands (`E####` errors, `W####` warnings, `X####` cross-surface integrity) are surface-local, human-facing codes the CLI prints, while the driver's camelCase names are payload-carrying LSP diagnostic codes (`phero_driver::DiagnosticCode`); both are first-class registry entries, cross-referenced by band. To allocate a code, claim (or find) your band in the ledger and add the constant plus its entry to the band module. Run `pherolang explain <code>` for one entry, or `pherolang explain --list` for everything.

docs.name: IFML.md
docs.title: IFML DSL
docs.description: A Domain-Specific Language that is semantically aligned with OMG IFML 1.0(https://www.omg.org/spec/IFML/) but uses a modern, C-like expression-heavy syntax instead of XML/XMI. Lexed by a **logos** lexer and parsed by **chumsky** into a spanned syntax tree, then lowered into a versioned `IfmlModel` artifact; the same parser and byte-offset spans back the language server.
